components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Brass foundry CTA — Ver misiones / Ver proyectos.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.875rem 1.375rem; background: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); color: var(--foundry-chrome, #1c1710); font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 8px 20px rgba(14, 10, 6, 0.4); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 88%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Brass Outline
components.description: Transparent brass-border CTA for cotización and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0.625rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 70%, transparent); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Seam Button
components.description: Seam-border mute control used for decline/secondary chrome actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--foundry-type-dim, #8a7a62); background: var(--foundry-ground, #2a2218); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pattern Plate
components.description: Wooden pattern plate with seam border, soft shadow, and dashed brass register.
components.html:
PAT-001 · ESCALA 1:1

Misión ejemplo

Descripción breve del patrón listo para fundir.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #4a3a28 0%, #2a2218 48%, #3d3124 100%); box-shadow: 4px 8px 20px rgba(14, 10, 6, 0.4); padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--foundry-type, #e8dcc8); border-radius: 0; } .ds-plate::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 10px; border: 1px dashed #8b6914; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-plate-id { display: block; position: relative; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-plate-title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--foundry-type-bright, #f3ead8); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-title { color: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); } .ds-plate-body { position: relative; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: Literata, "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); }

components.name: Chat Input
components.description: Squared ground field with seam border and brass focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); background: var(--foundry-ground, #2a2218); color: var(--foundry-type, #e8dcc8); padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--foundry-type-dim, #8a7a62); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 40%, #5c4a2e); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 30%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Foundry Nav
components.description: Fixed chrome bar with deep-brass bottom edge and stencil section links.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; background: var(--foundry-chrome, #1c1710); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--foundry-brass-deep, #8b6914); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--foundry-type-bright, #f3ead8); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-logo:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; height: 1px; width: 0; background: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); transition: width 300ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foundry-type-bright, #f3ead8); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a227; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tech Chip
components.description: Mono tech inventory stamp on mission plates.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); background: color-mix(in srgb, #1c1710 60%, transparent); padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); border-radius: 0; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #c9a227 50%, #5c4a2e); color: var(--foundry-type-bright, #f3ead8); }

components.name: Process Teach Diagram
components.description: Single didactic Idea → Arquitectura → Desarrollo → Producto figure used in Services.
components.css: .ds-teach { margin: 0; max-width: 48rem; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); background: color-mix(in srgb, #1c1710 70%, transparent); padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-teach-caption { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; text-align: center; font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--foundry-type-mute, #c4b49a); } .ds-teach-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 0.75rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-teach-step { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--foundry-seam, #5c4a2e); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #4a3a28 0%, #2a2218 48%, #3d3124 100%); padding: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 4px 8px 20px rgba(14, 10, 6, 0.4); } .ds-plate-id { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foundry-brass, #c9a227); } .ds-teach-label { font-family: "Big Shoulders Stencil", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--foundry-type-bright, #f3ead8); } .ds-teach-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--foundry-type-dim, #8a7a62); } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-teach-steps { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }

narrative.overview:
Buildforge’s public face reads as a warm workshop bench, not a neon agency template. The ground is sand-mold dark; surfaces are wooden pattern plates with brass registration marks; type is workshop-stenciled for brand and serif for craft reading. Density paces from a registered first viewport (rail + hero plate + teaser stack) into quieter mid-page teaching, then a denser mission catalog that settles onto a shared baseline.

The system refuses centered cyber-neon heroes, glitch clone logos, cyan/magenta scan frames, and icon-card service grids. Soft offset shadows with blur convey weight on wood; hard neobrutal blocks are out of world. Mono type is reserved for plate IDs, scales, and measurements — never for marketing headlines.
keyCharacteristics: Warm foundry dark ground with sand-mold texture and chrome rails
Pattern-wood plates with dashed brass register frames and corner marks
Big Shoulders Stencil + Literata + JetBrains Mono triad
Soft brown-black offset shadows; brass as scarce accent metal
Mission plates register on scroll (ease-out-expo); reduced-motion ships already registered

rules.name: The Scarce Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass fills CTAs, IDs, and focus — not large backgrounds. If a screen looks golden, pull brass back to chrome/wood.

rules.name: The Seam-Not-Glow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with foundry-seam borders; never cyan/magenta glows or neon outlines.

rules.name: The Mono Measurement Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for IDs, scales, status stamps, and tech chips — not for brand display or paragraph reading.

rules.name: The Stencil Brand Rule
rules.body: </BUILDFORGE> and display headlines stay Big Shoulders Stencil; do not substitute Orbitron, Geist, Inter, or Space Grotesk.

rules.name: The Soft Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows always blur; hard 0-blur neobrutal offsets are out of world.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nav and rails stay flat chrome with seam/brass borders — no drop shadow on the fixed bar.

dos: Do lead with craft: pattern plates, register marks, and real API missions before marketing claims.
Do keep brass scarce — CTAs, IDs, focus, and thin accents only.
Do use soft brown-black blurred shadows (4–6px offset, 20–28px blur).
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for plate IDs, scales, chips, and register metadata.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (mission plates pre-registered; no settle animation).
donts: Don't revive neon/cyan/magenta glitch clones, TypeAnimation hero loops, or scan-frame pulses.
Don't put marketing headlines in mono or swap display to Inter/Geist/Orbitron/Space Grotesk.
Don't invent hard neobrutal offset shadows or large rounded “SaaS cards” as the default plate.
Don't invent client logos, awards, or metrics not supplied by product/API content.
Don't spread icon-card service grids; services stay list + one teach-diagram + media.
